title: Highwoods at Shock Hill | KEY.co
description_expanded: Inside, the home is thoughtfully designed for both relaxation and connection. Three king suites, including a spacious main-level primary with a fireplace and spa-like bath, provide exceptional privacy for couples or families. A bunk room and sleeper sofa offer flexible sleeping arrangements, while the gourmet kitchen and open living spaces invite effortless entertaining. After a day on the slopes or trails, unwind in the private hot tub, gather around the fire pit, or enjoy a movie in the cozy downstairs den. With high-end amenities, ample gathering spaces, and direct access to skiing and hiking, Highwoods at Shock Hill delivers a truly unforgettable Breckenridge experience. Highwoods at Shock Hill is a stunning modern mountain retreat located in one of Breckenridge’s most exclusive neighborhoods. Just steps from the Gondola Mid-Station and minutes from Main Street, this luxury home blends rustic elegance with premium comfort. Reclaimed wood floors, native natural accents, and expansive windows create a warm, sophisticated atmosphere throughout. With its inclusion in The Pinnacle Collection, this residence offers an elevated standard of mountain living—complete with breathtaking alpine views, top-tier finishes, and a location that puts outdoor adventure right at your doorstep.
